title: Claude helped recreated my 2023 prototype: Auto Strike Manager
author: SwagBoiBanter
selftext:
Game can be played here for free (PC browser): [https://bigtesseract.itch.io/auto-strike-manager](https://bigtesseract.itch.io/auto-strike-manager)

I was learning to program games in Godot a few years back and started this project. The game brings together elements from autochess and counterstrike, however it is single player like a football manager.

You control what the team has and their initial movements within the mission, once you set them off you can only watch! There are upgrades you get after each contract and a final boss at the end. Fail 3 contracts, you fail the game. Each of your agents have 3 lives, and each agent will come with 2 syngergies.

Majority of the game was built by Opus 5.5 on Extra/Max, I basically just gave it my old game files and planning notes then asked it to recreate it in three.js. Everything you see in the game was created in code. It took about a month to playtest, provide feedback, polish up. There are lots more I could add to the game, but want to focus on other projects.

Please let me know if you have any questions.
